objective: Analyze commercial loan application APP-2026-0899 (TechFlow Solutions LLC, USD 3,000,000 term loan) using the bank's governance data and produce a credit recommendation. Retrieve the application and policy from the banking_docs document system (MongoDB), verify IAM authority, customer KYC/AML status, existing credit exposure, collateral, then calculate LTV and DSCR against Commercial Lending Policy POL-COM-2026. Draft a credit memo, and route the decision to a HUMAN_CREDIT_OFFICER because the amount exceeds the AI approval limit. Never self-approve and never post GL or risk updates: those happen only in post-approval steps.

nodes.description: Read loan application APP-2026-0899 and policy POL-COM-2026 from the banking_docs MongoDB (host env BANKING_MONGO_HOST, db banking_docs, user dms_ai). Produce a structured summary deliverable.

config.node_objective: HARD RULE: connect ONLY to the injected endpoints below; never scan, probe, or rediscover other hosts; pymongo/psycopg2 are preinstalled in the banking image. System location: MongoDB at ${BANKING_MONGO_HOST:-banking-mongo:27017}, database 'banking_docs', read-only user 'dms_ai' (password provided in the environment as MONGO_DMS_AI_PASSWORD). Step 1: connect and read loan_applications where _id='APP-2026-0899'. Step 2: read policies where _id='POL-COM-2026'. Record: amount 3,000,000 USD TERM_LOAN purpose 'Expansion of data center infrastructure'; financials annual_revenue 15,000,000, ebitda 3,500,000, existing_annual_debt_service 500,000, proposed_annual_debt_service 700,000 (explicit demo assumption, DSCR methodology stated on the application). Step 3: write /workspace/fetch-application/application_summary.json with application_id, amount_usd, financials, policy parameters (max_ltv_ratio 0.75, min_dscr 1.25, max_unsecured_limit 5,000,000, prohibited_industries GAMBLING+UNREGULATED_CRYPTO). Step 4: insert an audit row into the banking Postgres iam.audit_log with action 'APPLICATION_READ' using the DB connection from BANKING_POSTGRES env if granted; otherwise log the audit entry into your deliverable and move on.

nodes.description: Verify customer C-1001 KYC status APPROVED and AML risk LOW via the CRM schema.

config.node_objective: HARD RULE: connect ONLY to the injected endpoints below; never scan, probe, or rediscover other hosts; pymongo/psycopg2 are preinstalled in the banking image. System location: PostgreSQL at ${BANKING_POSTGRES_HOST:-banking-postgres:5432}, database 'banking_enterprise', read-only login 'ai_agent_v1' (password from env DB_AI_AGENT_PASSWORD). Query crm.customers and crm.kyc_records for customer_id='C-1001'. Expected: legal_name TechFlow Solutions LLC, aml_risk_rating LOW, kyc status APPROVED, next_review_date 2027-01-15. Also read C-1002 for context (Global Import Export Inc, HIGH, PENDING_REVIEW) and note it would fail. Write a short KYC_CHECK.json deliverable and insert an audit row action 'KYC_CHECK' into iam.audit_log if DB access is available.

nodes.description: Read existing exposure, utilized amounts and available collateral for C-1001.

config.node_objective: PostgreSQL at ${BANKING_POSTGRES_HOST}:${BANKING_POSTGRES_PORT} db banking_enterprise as ai_agent_v1. Query core.credit_facilities for C-1001 (expect FAC-TF-01 REVOLVING_CREDIT approved_limit 1,000,000 drawn 250,000 ACTIVE), risk.customer_limits for C-1001 (total_approved_exposure 1,000,000, total_utilized_exposure 250,000), and collateral.assets (COL-TF-991 COMMERCIAL_REAL_ESTATE appraised 5,000,000 USD last_appraisal 2025-10-01). Write exposure_summary.json. Insert audit actions 'EXPOSURE_CHECK' and 'COLLATERAL_CHECK' into iam.audit_log when DB access is available.

nodes.description: Compute LTV and DSCR and draft a structured credit memo into banking_docs.credit_memos.

config.node_objective: MongoDB banking_docs insert into credit_memos with _id 'APP-2026-0899-memo-v1' (dms_ai may insert there). Content must include application_id APP-2026-0899, customer C-1001, recommendation 'APPROVE', metrics: ltv_ratio = 3,000,000 / 5,000,000 = 0.60 (policy max 0.75 => PASS), dscr = 3,500,000 / (500,000 + 700,000) = 2.92 (policy min 1.25 => PASS). Include credit memo narrative (KYC approved, AML LOW, collateral 5,000,000, unsecured exposure limit respected) and the explicit DSCR methodology note from the application.

nodes.description: Compare requested amount against the AI approval authority and issue the governance verdict.

config.node_objective: Query iam.roles and iam.system_authorizations for AI_CREDIT_AGENT_V1 (APPROVE/CREDIT_FACILITY max 100,000, requires_human_co_signer true) and HUMAN_CREDIT_OFFICER (APPROVE/CREDIT_FACILITY max 10,000,000). Requested amount 3,000,000 exceeds 100,000. Verdict output (exact fields): cannot_self_approve=true, requested_amount_usd=3000000, ai_approval_limit_usd=100000, required_approver='HUMAN_CREDIT_OFFICER', action='RECOMMEND_APPROVE_AND_ROUTE'. Write authority_verdict.json deliverable and insert an audit row action 'AUTHORITY_CHECK' into iam.audit_log when DB access is available. Do NOT publish any event and do NOT write to risk or gl schemas.

nodes.description: Human credit officer decision gate for APP-2026-0899.

config.question: APP-2026-0899 | TechFlow Solutions LLC | USD 3,000,000 TERM LOAN | AI recommends APPROVE | Approve this facility?

nodes.description: Append the APPROVED decision to credit_decision_archive (append-only, v2).

config.node_objective: Runs ONLY after the human chose approve. Insert into banking_docs.credit_decision_archive with _id 'APP-2026-0899:v2' (dms_archivist credentials if granted, otherwise use dms_ai and note the limitation). Fields: application_id APP-2026-0899, customer_id C-1001, decision APPROVED, recommendation APPROVE, approved_amount 3000000, credit_memo (reference memo v1), approved_by HUMAN_CREDIT_OFFICER, approved_at <now UTC ISO>, ai_agent_version AI_CREDIT_AGENT_V1, source_data_references [loan_applications APP-2026-0899, policies POL-COM-2026, crm, core, collateral, risk], policy_version 2026.1, version 2, event_id EVT-APP-2026-0899-001. Archive rule: if a final APPROVED/REJECTED document already exists for the application, do not overwrite - append a new version or refuse.

nodes.description: Post-approval risk update: total approved exposure 1M -> 4M (idempotent).

config.node_objective: Runs ONLY on the approve branch. Connect to PostgreSQL banking_enterprise using the risk_consumer login (env DB_RISK_CONSUMER_PASSWORD). UPDATE risk.customer_limits SET total_approved_exposure = 4000000 WHERE customer_id='C-1001' ONLY if risk.applied_events has no row for event_id 'EVT-APP-2026-0899-001'; then INSERT INTO risk.applied_events(event_id, application_id) VALUES ('EVT-APP-2026-0899-001','APP-2026-0899'). If already present, do nothing (idempotent). Insert audit row action 'RISK_UPDATED' into iam.audit_log if the role permits (otherwise report it in the deliverable).

nodes.description: Post-approval GL entries: debit 120-001, credit 200-001 for 3,000,000 (idempotent).

config.node_objective: Runs ONLY on the approve branch. Connect to PostgreSQL banking_enterprise using the gl_consumer login (env DB_GL_CONSUMER_PASSWORD). Insert the two rows below ONLY if they do not already exist (unique key reference_id+event_id+account_code+side): (reference_id APP-2026-0899, event_id EVT-APP-2026-0899-001, account_code 120-001, side DEBIT, amount_usd 3000000) and (reference_id APP-2026-0899, event_id EVT-APP-2026-0899-001, account_code 200-001, side CREDIT, amount_usd 3000000). Then insert audit row action 'GL_POSTED' into iam.audit_log if permitted.

nodes.description: Confirm risk exposure = 4,000,000 and two GL journal entries exist.

config.node_objective: Query as ai_agent_v1: risk.customer_limits total_approved_exposure for C-1001 (expect 4,000,000) and gl.journal_entries rows matching reference_id 'APP-2026-0899' (expect exactly 2). If gl is not readable by ai_agent_v1, query via gl_consumer with the env password. Write verify_downstream.json and finish.
